mentions.name: SemanticDocs PDF form field detection (CommonForms)
mentions.description: ML models and a web service that automatically detect where form fields should go in PDF documents and make PDFs fillable. Code and models are open source on GitHub; the next step is training and releasing DETR models to improve quality, with the ultimate goal of automatic form accessibility.
mentions.problem: PDFs are not fillable and users must manually place form fields.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Training ML models for PDF forms. You can try out what I’ve got so far with this service that automatically detects where fields should go and makes PDFs fillable: https://detect.semanticdocs.org/
Code and models are at: https://github.com/jbarrow/commonforms
